items.name: Boots
items.description: Sturdy footwear designed for walking long distances.

items.name: Cloak
items.description: A long, loose outer garment worn for warmth or protection.

items.name: Fine Garments
items.effect: Boon on CHA-based skills when the GM finds it reasonable.
items.description: Expensive and elegant clothing, often made from luxurious materials.

items.name: Fur

items.description: Basic clothing suitable for everyday wear.
